editions.title: Last week on E-Grid
editions.intro: Three rounds took place this week, all on Sunday 18 October: the Clio Cup Series came to Navarra, the NASCAR Cup Series reached Phoenix for round 33, and NHRA Drag Racing raced the FallNationals at Texas.

items.headline: Navarra
items.detail: Circuito de Navarra, Spain · Sun 18 Oct
items.body: The sixth round of the Clio Cup Series came to the Circuito de Navarra in Spain on Sunday 18 October. Drivers took to the track for a full weekend of racing around the Spanish circuit.

items.headline: Freeway Insurance 500
items.body: Tyler Reddick won the Freeway Insurance 500 at Phoenix Raceway from sixth on the grid, holding off Ryan Blaney of Team Penske and Chase Elliott of Hendrick Motorsports by 0.801 seconds. Six cautions for 43 laps shuffled a field in which Christopher Bell led the most laps, while Kyle Larson's race ended with an accident. The weekend narrowed Larson's Chase lead over Christopher Bell from 49 to just 5 points, with three races remaining.
facts: Tyler Reddick won from 6th on the grid
Kyle Larson's Chase lead over Christopher Bell went from 49 to 5 points this weekend, with 3 races to go

items.headline: Texas FallNationals
items.body: The NHRA Drag Racing series came to the Texas Motorplex in Ennis for the FallNationals on Sunday 18 October. Drivers took to the track for a full weekend of racing at the circuit.

items.headline: Navarra
items.detail: Circuito de Navarra, Spain · Sun 18 Oct

items.headline: Texas FallNationals
items.body: The NHRA Drag Racing series returns with the Texas FallNationals at the Texas Motorplex in Ennis on Sunday 18 October. It is a full day of drag racing, as drivers line up for their run down the track.

lastRaces.headline: Texas FallNationals
lastRaces.body: The Texas FallNationals brought drag racing to the Texas Motorplex in Ennis on Sunday 18 October. Competitors lined up across the season's classes for a weekend of quarter-mile action.

lastRaces.headline: Freeway Insurance 500
lastRaces.body: Tyler Reddick won the Freeway Insurance 500 at Phoenix Raceway, taking the flag by 0.801s after starting from sixth, ahead of Ryan Blaney for Team Penske and Chase Elliott for Hendrick Motorsports. It was a close contest, with 21 lead changes across 312 laps. Larson's championship lead over Christopher Bell then fell from 49 to just 5 points with three races remaining.
facts: Tyler Reddick won from 6th on the grid
Kyle Larson's Chase lead over Christopher Bell went from 49 to 5 points this weekend, with 3 races to go

lastRaces.headline: Navarra
lastRaces.detail: Circuito de Navarra, Spain · Sun 18 Oct
lastRaces.body: Round six of the Clio Cup Series ran at the Circuito de Navarra in Spain on Sunday 18 October. Drivers took to the short Spanish circuit for another leg of the championship.

lastRaces.headline: Grand Prix of Indonesia
lastRaces.detail: Pertamina Mandalika Circuit, Indonesia · Sun 11 Oct
lastRaces.body: Marco Bezzecchi took the Grand Prix of Indonesia by 4.3 seconds from Raul Fernandez, with Jorge Martin completing a Aprilia one-two-three on the podium. He set a new lap record of 1:29.960 in dry heat, while Francesco Bagnaia, Toprak Razgatlioglu, Jack Miller and Fermin Aldeguer all failed to finish. Martin now leads the championship by just two points over Marc Marquez.
facts: Marco Bezzecchi won by 4.3 seconds from Raul Fernandez
Did not finish: Toprak Razgatlioglu, Jack Miller, Francesco Bagnaia and Fermin Aldeguer
Marco Bezzecchi set a new lap record, 1:29.960
Saturday's sprint was won by Marc Marquez
Jorge Martin leads the championship by 2 points from Marc Marquez

lastRaces.headline: Singapore Grand Prix
lastRaces.detail: Marina Bay Street Circuit, Singapore · Sun 11 Oct
lastRaces.body: Max Verstappen won the Singapore Grand Prix from pole, 7.3 seconds clear of Charles Leclerc, with Andrea Kimi Antonelli third for Mercedes. A virtual safety car twice interrupted a dry race in which Leclerc took the fastest lap and Isack Hadjar climbed from 22nd to 10th. Antonelli's championship lead over George Russell grew to 102 points this weekend.
facts: Max Verstappen won from pole, 7.3 seconds ahead of Charles Leclerc
Biggest climbers: Isack Hadjar from 22nd to 10th and George Russell from 19th to 9th
Did not finish: Alexander Albon, Lance Stroll, Franco Colapinto and Gabriel Bortoleto
Andrea Kimi Antonelli's championship lead over George Russell went from 84 to 102 points over the weekend
Virtual safety car on laps 8 and 39

lastRaces.headline: Rally Italia Sardegna
lastRaces.body: World Rally Championship's Rally Italia Sardegna came around Alghero in Italy on Sunday 4 October, forming round 13 of the season. It was another demanding test across Sardinia for the leading crews as they pressed on through the latter half of the calendar.

lastRaces.headline: Motul Petit Le Mans
lastRaces.detail: Michelin Raceway Road Atlanta · Sat 3 Oct
lastRaces.body: IMSA's SportsCar Championship reaches its finale with the Motul Petit Le Mans at Michelin Raceway Road Atlanta on Saturday 3 October. The endurance marathon has long stood as the series' crowning event, capping another demanding season of sports car racing.

lastRaces.headline: 6 Hours of Fuji
lastRaces.body: The World Endurance Championship turned to Fuji Speedway in Japan on Sunday 27 September for the 6 Hours of Fuji. The circuit's steep climb past the summit has again defined this round, testing drivers and machines across a full endurance distance.

lastRaces.headline: Baku
lastRaces.detail: Baku City Circuit, Azerbaijan · Sun 27 Sep
lastRaces.body: Formula 2 brought its sprint and feature races to the Baku City Circuit in Azerbaijan on Sunday 27 September. The narrow street track threading the old city's walls offered another tight, technical test for the feeder series.

lastRaces.headline: Madrid
lastRaces.body: Formula 3's tenth round came to Madrid, Spain on Sunday 13 September. The championship's Spanish round brought its racing to the city that weekend.

lastRaces.headline: Monza (double-header)
lastRaces.detail: Autodromo Nazionale Monza, Italy · Sun 6 Sep
lastRaces.body: Autodromo Nazionale Monza has hosted racing since 1922, its 5.793 km lap threading through 11 corners. The Porsche Supercup's seventh round ran here on Sunday 6 September as a double-header in Italy.

lastRaces.headline: Season Finale
lastRaces.detail: WeatherTech Raceway Laguna Seca · Sun 6 Sep
lastRaces.body: IndyCar's season finale reached WeatherTech Raceway Laguna Seca on Sunday 6 September. As the championship's final round of the year, it brought the season to a close at the venue.

lastRaces.headline: London E-Prix
lastRaces.body: Taylor Barnard won in London for DS Penske, completing a Mahindra Racing one-two as Nyck De Vries took second and Edoardo Mortara third. The result leaves Pascal Wehrlein five points clear at the top of the championship, ahead of Jake Dennis.
facts: Pascal Wehrlein leads the championship by 5 points from Jake Dennis
